architecture: Mavenu AI SaaS Platform Development Architecture V4 page 43

storage_design.source: V26 38-row invented tenant/site relational fixture in temporary V23/V24.1 schema version 2
storage_design.lifecycle: isolated disposable SQLite file mavenu-v28-*/v28_lifecycle.sqlite3, NOT a V23 schema upgrade or production archive
storage_design.retention_clock: synthetic lifecycle age assigned by case suffix; source occurred_at_utc is NOT treated as observed real-world history
storage_design.hold_behavior: no move or purge while held; explicit simulated release needed; never automatically expires

risks: Policy durations (14/30/90 days) are demonstrative assumptions and are not supplied as approved legal or Minn-Dak contractual periods.
Prototype's legal hold is a simulated flag and untrusted reviewer string; no authentic legal authority or approved hold-release workflow exists.
SQLite DELETE is a logical physical-row deletion within a temporary store, not proof of secure erasure of filesystem pages, journals, backups or external replicas.
Source V26 database, V24/V27 backups, frozen fixtures and immutable historical evidence are deliberately untouched; a production deletion plan must address every derived copy.
Hash-only tombstone and event chain are deterministic integrity diagnostics, not independently signed tamper-evident custody or compliant personal-data deletion.
No unattended lifecycle scheduler, live retention policy, production tenant authentication/RLS or actual customer data permission.
V10 and V20 formal phase signoffs and all V21–V28 owner/security/legal approvals remain outstanding.
human_readiness_gates: Identify customer data controller and lawful purpose/retention requirement by data class
Approve sensitive-record, legal hold and litigation preservation requirements
Define and test retention across active stores, archives, backups, exports, caches and disaster-recovery replicas
Approve secure deletion, cryptographic erasure or provider-specific purge standards and immutable audit evidence
Implement authenticated reviewer identity and dual-control legal-hold release with audit chain external trust
Approve tenant access/RLS, lifecycle scheduler, retention monitoring, legal DPA and operational responsibilities
Complete V10/V20 and V21–V28 independent release signoffs
